headline: ams OSRAM LSP role combines RNM model validation, UVM integration and AMS top-level checks
fact: ams OSRAM posted a Bucharest ASIC Analog Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer role in its Light Sensors & Photonics business unit. The position defines verification strategies and plans, develops and validates analog and real-number behavioral models, integrates analog models into UVM mixed-signal testbenches, and executes top-level AMS verification with automatic checks. The qualifications name SystemVerilog RNM, Verilog-AMS, analog checkers, reusable verification components and scripting.

sources.title: ams OSRAM: ASIC Analog Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer (24163)
